scope: Default molecular dataset for upcoming numerical experiments. Historical run configurations and outputs retain their exact pins.
approximations: Finite basis and strength floor; frozen-ground vibrational bands; empirical and copied collision rates; limited ortho-H2/He coverage; isotope scaling. See companion for quantitative scope.
publication: Release v1.0 distributes the approved source and derived products. The 97 original inputs are separately held.
legacy_DAT_title: The literal [EXPERIMENTAL] tag is a historical label frozen into the v3 bytes. The 6 November 2026 adoption supersedes that label; it is not the current use status.
